content.value_statement: Mobile teams need practical ASO decisions across keywords, metadata, reviews, and launch timing. This skill turns app details and store data into prioritized optimization actions.
actual_capabilities: Analyzes keyword relevance, competition, estimated volume, and long-tail opportunities.
Optimizes Apple App Store and Google Play metadata within platform character limits.
Scores ASO health across metadata, ratings, keyword performance, and conversion metrics.
Plans A/B tests for icons, screenshots, descriptions, and other listing assets.
Creates localization priorities, adapted keywords, and translation validation guidance.
Analyzes public reviews for sentiment, issues, themes, and feature requests.
limitations: Keyword volume estimates are approximate because stores do not publish exact search data.
Private analytics, revenue data, and unpublished reviews must be provided by the user.
Store algorithms and policy requirements can change without notice.
Paid acquisition strategy and ad campaign planning are outside the skill scope.

use_cases.title: Prepare a New App Launch
use_cases.description: Create keyword targets, launch metadata, store checklist items, and release timing recommendations before submission.

use_cases.title: Improve an Existing Listing
use_cases.description: Audit current metadata, review themes, ASO score, and test opportunities for higher organic conversion.

use_cases.title: Plan Market Localization
use_cases.description: Prioritize countries, adapt keyword strategy, validate translated metadata, and estimate localization impact.

prompt_templates.title: Find Starter Keywords
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner keyword research for a new app.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find ASO keyword opportunities for my [category] app. My audience is [audience], and the main features are [features].

prompt_templates.title: Rewrite Store Metadata
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate metadata optimization for one platform.
prompt_templates.prompt: Optimize my [Apple App Store or Google Play] listing. Use these current fields: [metadata]. Target these keywords: [keywords].

prompt_templates.title: Audit Competitor Positioning
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare my app with [competitors]. Identify keyword gaps, metadata patterns, visual asset opportunities, and ranking risks.

prompt_templates.title: Build an ASO Growth Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning across research, testing, reviews, and localization.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 90-day ASO plan using my metadata, rankings, reviews, conversion data, target markets, and launch calendar.

output_examples.input: A productivity app needs better Apple App Store keywords.
output_examples.output: A ranked keyword shortlist, relevance scores, competition notes, long-tail options, and Apple keyword field guidance.

output_examples.input: A fitness app has weak Google Play conversion.
output_examples.output: Rewritten title and descriptions, keyword density notes, screenshot test ideas, and priority actions for the listing.

output_examples.input: A travel app wants to expand into Spanish and German markets.
output_examples.output: Market priority ranking, localized keyword themes, translation checks, cultural notes, and expected ASO impact.

best_practices: Provide current metadata, target keywords, category, audience, and store performance data.
Validate every recommendation against current Apple and Google policy before publishing.
Run controlled tests and track rankings, conversion, reviews, and downloads after changes.
anti_patterns: Do not copy competitor keywords without checking feature relevance and policy risk.
Do not overfill descriptions with repeated keywords that reduce clarity or trust.
Do not change many listing elements at once when measuring test results.

faq.question: Does this skill publish changes to app stores?
faq.answer: No. It provides recommendations, copy, checklists, and test plans for manual review and publishing.

faq.question: Can it work for both Apple and Google stores?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes separate character limits and metadata rules for Apple App Store and Google Play.

faq.question: Does it need real performance data?
faq.answer: It can start with app details, but rankings, conversion, and review data improve the recommendations.

faq.question: Can it analyze user reviews?
faq.answer: Yes. It can summarize public review sentiment, common issues, themes, and feature requests.

faq.question: Does it include paid advertising strategy?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on organic discovery, store metadata, conversion, reviews, localization, and launch planning.

faq.question: How often should ASO work be repeated?
faq.answer: Review keywords and metadata quarterly, and after major app updates, market changes, or ranking drops.
